# Captain Cat — a cozy VR adventure in a purradise afterlife 🐾🌴

You’re a cat who’s crossed the Rainbow Bridge… and landed in a sunlit archipelago of tropical islands. Sail between shores, meet quirky feline locals, complete relaxing quests, and reel in seven rare fish to find your way back home. Upgrade your boat, customize your look, and explore at your own pace—**no timers, no stress, just good vibes and discovery.**

[media]

**Features:**

- Cozy exploration in a tropical cat-afterlife 🌞

- Island-hopping quests with charming feline characters

- Relaxing fishing, fruit picking, and light crafting

- Boat upgrades and gentle progression—play your way

- Chill soundtrack, ambient audio, and photo-ready vistas 📸

- Comfort-first VR options (snap/continuous, vignettes, seated/standing)

- Collectibles, cosmetics, and secrets hidden across the islands

- Accessible, low-pressure gameplay perfect for unwinding

[media]

**Early Access: Play now and help us improve our game! 🎣**

Supported by TAICCA and the Taiwan Ministry of Culture as part of the 2025 Innovative Co-production: VR Game Early Access Production Program.

Developed by Acorn Den VR Studio.
